title: Triage bridge: agenda, decisions, and open questions - 2027-04-05
content:
Meeting: Triage Bridge (weekly sync)
Date: 2027-04-05 10:00-10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #sec-triage Slack bridge
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Note-taker: Markus Lee
Attendees: Aisha, Markus, Sofia, Priya, Daniel, Ravi (joined late)

Purpose: quick cross-functional handoff between vuln triage, secrets remediation, and threat-modeling teams. Keep decisions small, assign owners, and identify blockers for escalation to SRE/product as needed.

Agenda:
- Quick status roundup (5m): backlog skew, high-severity tickets, oncall handoffs
- Deep-dive 1 (15m): VULN-1178 (third-party dependency crypto misuse) - triage -> remediation window
- Deep-dive 2 (10m): Secrets map pruning proposal and rollout plan for automated scanning exclusion rules
- Threat modeling sync (5m): new feature rollout (dedicated routing) and potential auth/MTLS pitfalls
- Open questions / escalations (5m)
- Action items / owners (5m)

Notes / Discussion Highlights:
1) Status roundup:
- Backlog: ~62 active vuln tickets, 7 P1/P0 open (mostly dependency & secrets exposures).
- Oncall: last 48h surge handled; no incidents escalated to SRE. Need to rotate next-week pager (Priya -> Daniel).

2) VULN-1178 (crypto misuse in vendor lib):
- Summary: vendor library xcrypto v2.3.0 uses non-constant-time comparison in HMAC verify; PoC exists internally. Severity: high for token validation paths.
- Evidence: internal PoC in GH PR repo/infra#4821; exploit requires MITM+timing but product-critical when combined with bearer token flows.
- Decision: schedule emergency patch window with infra team. Short-term mitigation: add request-side timing noise + strict token expiry enforcement. Long-term: replace xcrypto usage in token_verifier module.
- Owner(s): Markus to drive PR (GH PR draft by EOD 4/6), Ravi to coordinate infra patch window and canary rollout (target 4/9).
- Blockers: kernel-level timing noise not acceptable for high-throughput path; need perf sign-off from SRE. Action: Markus to open PERF-req ticket and loop in Lina (SRE) for 4/7 sync.

3) Secrets map pruning & scanner exclusion rules:
- Problem: scanner noise from historical terraform state files and archived creds; creates triage fatigue and high false-positive counts for junior oncall.
- Proposal: create a pruning job that archives old state buckets to cold storage and adds verified exclusions to scanner ruleset (time-boxed, audited).
- Key requirements: exclusions must be auditable (who added, why, TTL), must expire automatically after 180 days unless renewed.
- Decision: approve pilot for 30-day run in staging with strict audit logging.
- Owner(s): Sofia to implement staged job and add audit scaffold (Confluence notes + code). Priya will validate sample outputs and produce acceptance criteria. Target: pilot start 4/12.
- Linked artifacts: confluence/attack-surface-map (map section: secrets -> terraform-buckets), JIRA:SEC-3421 for the pruning epic.

4) Threat-modeling quick sync (dedicated routing feature):
- Feature: route requests to dedicated capacity pools (customer pinned models). Potential threats surfaced:
  - Cross-tenant misrouting (policy misconfiguration) -> confidentiality risk
  - PKI/MTLS mis-issuance during autoscaling -> elevated attack surface
- Immediate asks: Product to publish design doc with exact routing control-plane interactions (deadline 4/13). Threat modeling team to run a table-top for misrouting scenarios on 4/14.
- Owner(s): Daniel to request design doc from Product (tag: product-dedicated). Priya to schedule table-top and invite SRE/infra.

5) Open questions / escalations:
- Should we temporarily raise severity for all dependency crypto issues until a policy is finalized? (short answer: yes, until we have a validated risk matrix). Action: Aisha to propose updated severity matrix by 4/8.
- How to measure scanner exclusion effectiveness? Need baseline false-positive rate metric. Action: Sofia to propose metric extraction query by 4/9.
- Is there appetite to add a "timing-hardening" middleware in front of token endpoints? SRE concerned about perf. Decision: prototype only, perf-gate required. Markus to prototype for dev-only traffic by 4/11.

Action Items (owner -> due):
- Markus Lee -> open GH PR for token_verifier refactor (draft) by 2027-04-06
- Ravi Shah -> coordinate infra patch window and canary plan for VULN-1178 by 2027-04-09
- Aisha Patel -> publish proposed urgency/severity matrix update to Confluence and slack by 2027-04-08
- Sofia Gonzalez -> implement pruning pilot job + audit logs, produce acceptance criteria by 2027-04-11; prepare metric query for scanner FP baseline by 2027-04-09
- Priya Menon -> schedule threat-modeling table-top for dedicated-routing on 2027-04-14 and invite stakeholders by 2027-04-07; validate pruning pilot outputs
- Daniel Ruiz -> request product design doc for dedicated routing (deadline 2027-04-13) and follow up if not received by 4/10
- Markus -> open PERF-req ticket and loop Lina (SRE) for perf sign-off meeting 2027-04-07

Decisions (quick list):
- Approve emergency patch + canary plan for VULN-1178 (owners: Markus, Ravi)
- Approve secrets-pruning pilot (owners: Sofia, Priya)
- Prototype timing-hardening middleware only for dev/testing; requires perf gate for prod

Risks & Notes to escalate:
- If infra can't provide a low-risk canary window, we may need to throttle rollout, increasing exploitation window for VULN-1178 (escalate to VP Eng if we hit scheduling conflicts).
- Scanner exclusion TTL must be enforced programmatically to avoid permanent blind spots.

Follow-ups for next meeting (2027-04-12):
- PR status update (Markus)
- Canary readiness & perf sign-off (Ravi + Lina)
- Pruning pilot staging results (Sofia)
- Severity matrix draft review (Aisha)

Notes-to-self / loose scribbles:
- Consider adding a small, queryable dashboard for "scanner noise by source" (priority low)
- Keep a 1-line summary in the oncall handover doc for any ongoing canaries (so ops don't miss it)

Attachments / Reference links:
- GH PR draft: repo/infra#4821 (internal)
- Confluence: attack-surface-map (secrets section)
- JIRA: VULN-1178, SEC-3421
- Slack thread: #sec-triage-thread-2027-04-04

End of notes.
